fields.description:
Scope: `src/rebar/llm/**` excluding plan_review and workflow — the package root plus code_review, prompting, review_kernel, evals, criteria, overlap. ~218 lines leave.

Contains the repo's #1 hotspot: `runner.py` 797/800, 88 commits, 12 in five days, with a 371-line method at its C901 ceiling. Recovering ~45 lines takes headroom from 3 to ~48 — roughly 4-5 stories of runway WITHOUT another split. ADR 0056 measured prose at 40% of `run()` and 50% of its pre-call region.

A self-contradicting module: THREE sites assert Anthropic 400s when extended thinking meets a native output constraint, while `structured.py:228-238` — 210 lines below one of them, in the same file — explicitly calls that 'a stale rationale' and 'a relic'.

A dead field found via its own comment: `runner.py:94-97` says `extra_tools` 'is always None in practice'; grep confirms no caller sets it. Delete the field, not the comment.

Confirmed exemplar for the maintainer's original finding: `capabilities.py:166-198` is structurally a complete ADR (security posture for a BLOCKING gate, three numbered bounds, an explicitly accepted limitation on domain controls) and NO ADR in the 83-file corpus mentions web search in any form.

85 lines are free wins — history already citing b690, b300, 2682, 3a98, 7a79, e3cd, 8455. `providers.py:3-16` duplicates ADR 0059 §1 verbatim including its file:line citations.

capabilities.py:295-316 is a matrix that cost real AWS accounts to produce and says so; capabilities.py:269-281 carries a rejected-alternative warning sitting exactly where the next reader would reintroduce it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every non-KEEP unit in scope is relocated or deleted per its destination
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands
- [ ] Verified-stale comments are corrected where they document a live invariant, deleted only where obsolete
- [ ] No load-bearing invariant is lost; measured-fact and anti-refactor warnings stay verbatim
## CORRECTION (plan defect + plan-review preempt, parent 373f disposition vocabulary)

The plan's `extra_tools` premise is FALSE and would cause a regression if executed literally.
`extra_tools` is LIVE, not dead: `llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py:469,665` set it (the
token-recovery record tool, story 2948), `llm/workflow/runs.py` threads it end-to-end, and
`tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_banking.py:491` asserts `captured.get("extra_tools")`
("the record tool is still wired"). The STALE unit is the `runner.py` comment claiming it "is
always None in practice" — that is CORRECTED in place; the field is DO_NOT_MOVE (load-bearing).
Superseding ACs below encode this and the 373f disposition rules.

## Acceptance Criteria (supersedes the list above)

- [ ] Every substantial in-scope comment unit is dispositioned into exactly one parent-373f
      label: RELOCATE (to an ADR / docs / ticket, reduced to a one-line citation), DELETE, KEEP,
      DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE.
- [ ] Decision rule CORRECT-vs-DELETE: a comment documenting CURRENT runtime behavior / a live
      invariant is CORRECTED in place; a comment is DELETED only when the thing it describes no
      longer exists (artifact removed, or superseded). Every DELETE records its reason
      (referenced-artifact-gone / superseded) in the commit body or a ticket comment.
- [ ] `runner.py` `extra_tools` field is KEPT (DO_NOT_MOVE — load-bearing via
      completion_recovery/runs.py/tests); its stale "always None in practice" comment is
      CORRECTED to reflect the story-2948 record-tool wiring (or deleted as superseded), with the
      reason recorded. The field and its two call sites are NOT removed.
- [ ] The three sites asserting an Anthropic-400 on extended-thinking + native-output-constraint
      vs `structured.py:228-238` calling that rationale "stale"/"a relic" are RECONCILED
      conservatively: determine which matches current runtime and CORRECT the stale side in
      place; if the truth is not determinable from the code without behavior risk, KEEP both
      verbatim (DO_NOT_MOVE) and file a `discovered_from` ticket rather than guess. No
      load-bearing invariant is deleted on uncertainty.
- [ ] The web-search capability security-posture block (`capabilities.py:166-198` — a structurally
      complete ADR: BLOCKING-gate posture, three numbered bounds, an accepted limitation) is
      RELOCATED into a NEW ADR with a unique unused number (>= 0063), which EXISTS and is
      committed BEFORE the source comment is collapsed to a one-line citation.
- [ ] Measured-fact and anti-refactor comments stay VERBATIM (DO_NOT_MOVE): the AWS-cost capability
      matrix (`capabilities.py:295-316`) and the rejected-alternative warning
      (`capabilities.py:269-281`). `providers.py:3-16` duplicating ADR 0059 §1 verbatim is
      collapsed to a one-line citation.
- [ ] The shard's do_not_move list is appended to `.joe-janitor/tools.md` BEFORE any edit lands;
      lint/type pragmas (`# noqa`, `# type: ignore`, `# ruff:`, `# tickets-boundary-ok`) and
      test-introspected docstrings are DO_NOT_MOVE.
- [ ] The actual recovered comment-line count is measured (by diff) and recorded on this ticket
      as an OUTPUT, not a target.
- [ ] No behaviour change: the full test suite AND `make lint` / `make typecheck` pass unchanged.
